title: Combination Sum III
statement: Find every combination of `k` distinct integers from 1..9 that sum to `n`. Sort each combination and sort the list.
hints: This is combinations of a fixed size with a sum constraint.
Choose numbers in increasing order so each combination is generated once.
Prune when the remaining sum is negative or the remaining count cannot be filled.

approaches.name: Backtracking
approaches.explanation: The same search with early exits.

editorial: Start from 1 and append a number larger than the previous one. Decrease the remaining sum and the remaining count. Record the path when both hit zero. Skip a branch whose next number already exceeds the remainder.
